name: Xi'an

rounds.endCondition: Game ends after the 6th turn when all worker cards are used

categories.label: Prestige track (before final scoring)
categories.labelVi: Điểm trên track (trước tính điểm cuối)
categories.hint: Position on the prestige points track after turn 6, before the end-game scoring below.

categories.label: Painting majority: section A
categories.labelVi: Đa số tượng sơn: khu A
categories.hint: Count your painted warriors in section A; ranks score 10/5/2 (ties split, rounded down).

categories.label: Painting majority: section B
categories.labelVi: Đa số tượng sơn: khu B
categories.hint: Count your painted warriors in section B; ranks score 12/6/3 (ties split, rounded down).

categories.label: Painting majority: section C
categories.labelVi: Đa số tượng sơn: khu C
categories.hint: Count your painted warriors in section C; ranks score 14/7/4 (ties split, rounded down).

categories.label: Bronze equipment: different cards in set
categories.labelVi: Trang bị đồng: số loại khác nhau

categories.label: Wood equipment: different cards in set
categories.labelVi: Trang bị gỗ: số loại khác nhau

categories.label: Warriors matching forged equipment
categories.hint: 3 pp per own warrior whose pit section letter matches a different equipment card (each warrior matches only one card).

categories.label: Unused tiles
categories.hint: 1 pp per unused bonus tile (not flipped face down).

categories.label: Game end tile bonus
categories.hint: Points from the game end tile you picked (only if you reached the end of the supervisor track); compute per tile text.

categories.label: Leftover resources
categories.hint: Count coins + clay + pigment blocks together; 1 pp per set of 3.

categories.label: Supervisor track position (tiebreak)
categories.hint: Further along the supervisor track wins; on the same space the top of the stack wins (enter higher number).

tiebreakers.description: Player further ahead on the supervisor track

notes: family: area-majority. Most points (turn-end majorities, buildings, helpers, penalties of 2 pp per unpaid coin) are accumulated live on the prestige track; the scorer enters that track value then final categories. Game end tile options (resources back to stock +1 per resource max 15, +1 per 10pp, +3 per unused mausoleum tile, +2 per own painted warrior, +2 per helper, +6, +5 per area majority up to 15, +4 per identical equipment pair) are entered as one number in gameEndBonus. Rulebook's 'Mausoleum' step is ambiguous about whether only bonus tiles or all unflipped tiles with pp count; modelled as unflipped tiles x1. 2-player rules only change payment for sharing a building.
